modules.tagline: Tiny and quick, for very small computers

modules.name: Gemma 3 1B
modules.tagline: Small and fluent
modules.description: Google's small model. Good everyday answers for its size. About 2 GB of memory.

modules.name: Llama 3.2 1B
modules.tagline: A good first model
modules.description: Meta's 1 billion parameter model. Sensible answers on a Raspberry Pi 4/5 or any laptop. About 2 GB of memory.

modules.name: Qwen 2.5 1.5B
modules.tagline: Balanced
modules.description: Noticeably better than the 0.5B at reasoning and writing. About 3 GB of memory.

modules.name: Llama 3.2 3B
modules.tagline: Better answers, needs a real computer
modules.description: Meta's 3 billion parameter model. Clearly stronger; wants a laptop with 8 GB of memory or a Raspberry Pi 5. About 4 GB of memory.

modules.name: Qwen 2.5 3B
modules.tagline: Strong at facts and instructions
modules.description: About 4 GB of memory.

modules.name: Phi 3.5 mini
modules.tagline: Reasoning-focused
modules.description: Microsoft's 3.8 billion parameter model, good at step-by-step reasoning. About 5 GB of memory.

modules.name: Qwen 2.5 7B
modules.tagline: The most capable here
modules.description: Best answers of this list. Needs a computer with 16 GB of memory and patience on a CPU. About 8 GB of memory.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.blurb: Medicine, water, food, first aid, a Wikipedia starter and a world map. The smallest set that is still useful in an emergency.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.blurb: Adds repair, DIY, gardening, cooking, electronics, textbooks, travel guides and the tools.

tiers.name: Comprehensive
tiers.blurb: Adds a large encyclopedia, books, Khan Academy, more textbooks and detailed US and Europe maps. Needs a lot of space.

topics.name: Medicine
topics.description: Medical references, guides, and encyclopedias for healthcare information and emergency preparedness.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.description: Core medical references for first aid, medications, and emergency care. Start here.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.description: Comprehensive medical encyclopedia with detailed health information. Includes everything in Essential.

tiers.name: Comprehensive
tiers.description: Professional-level medical references and textbooks. Includes everything in Standard.

topics.name: Survival & preparedness
topics.description: Emergency preparedness, bug-out planning, and tactical survival skills for crisis situations.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.description: Water, food, and knot references plus core survival videos. Start here for emergency basics.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.description: Official disaster planning, field skills, and radio communications, plus bug-out and urban survival techniques. Includes everything in Essential.

tiers.name: Comprehensive
tiers.description: Complete prepper library - post-disaster recovery, growing and storing food, off-grid technical references, and classic military strategy. Includes everything in Standard.

topics.name: Education
topics.description: Encyclopedias, textbooks, tutorials, and educational videos for self-directed learning.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.description: Core reference materials - open textbooks and essential educational content. Lightweight, text-focused.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.description: Adds educational videos, university-level tutorials, and STEM textbooks. Includes Essential.

tiers.name: Comprehensive
tiers.description: Complete educational library with enhanced textbooks and TED talks. Includes Standard.

topics.name: Repair & DIY
topics.description: Fix it yourself - repair guides, home improvement, woodworking, and vehicle maintenance.

tiers.name: Essential
tiers.description: Core repair knowledge - woodworking basics and vehicle maintenance Q&A.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.description: Home improvement expertise with thousands of Q&A threads. Includes Essential.

tiers.name: Comprehensive
